method: Reconstructed the adopted B4.1 credit split and Appendix 1 term sequence, then independently reread the dated language and project entry requirements before reassessing the frozen record, selected workbook evidence and interests.
findings: The adopted broad track contains 60 EC in each year. Six first-year core units and four 6 EC language modules cover the first year. The first complete guide language example after the empty Catalan branch is Czech, with sequential completion in blocks 1, 2, 4 and 5. Phonetics precedes Transcription. Academic Literacy Test and tutoring add no credits. The separate sign-language track is not included.

The research progression is the first-year group project, year-two Linguistic Theories, year-three Research Methods & Statistics, the 6 EC Specialization and the 12 EC independent thesis. Linguistic Theories requires positive BSA, Introduction to Linguistics and a prior structural course. The regular thesis is after Specialization and requires it alongside Introduction to Linguistics, Linguistic Theories and positive BSA. The 30 EC of free electives remain open.

The two UCR plans have 24 distinct courses each. Psycholinguistics moves to 2027h1 in both after Introduction to Brain & Behavior. The discourse plan uses Rhetoric in Action in 2029h1 and substitutes Communicating the Climate Crisis for New Issues in Contemporary Social Theory. This adds applied analysis of framing while preserving qualitative inquiry, literature, media and persuasion. The 97.5 EC difference each way is substantive.

The direct alignment is strongest in psycholinguistics, stylistics and language learning, and partly in empirical methods. General neurobiology and developmental psychology support the cognition route without matching dedicated neurolinguistics or first-language acquisition. Generic computing does not supply a technical linguistic sequence. All 25 external components, 37 UCR titles and descriptions, two concepts, notes, links and audience references were reconciled. Optional UCR independent research remains outside scheduled credits.
